description: Android 17 update brings various new features, fresh animations, and security and privacy tools. Among the many new functionalities, Google has also introduced the new Bubbles feature for enhanced multitasking, which allows users to convert any app into a compact floating window by long-pressing the app icon. Users can view multiple apps at once as Bubbles, as the floating windows are stacked on top of each other for easy access. Google has also introduced a dedicated Bubble Bar, available only for devices with larger screens, such as tablets and foldables. This bar displays all the apps that have been converted into Bubbles and are currently in use, acting as a dock.
title: How to Use App Bubbles on Android 17 for Improved Multitasking, App Switching

description: Motorola launched the Edge 70 Pro+ in India in June, powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 8500 chipset, while Xiaomi brought the 17T with a Leica-branded camera system. From budget offerings to premium smartphones, consumers had plenty of new options to choose from this month. Here is a roundup of the smartphones launched in India this month.
title: Smartphones Launched in India (June 2026): Motorola Edge 70 Pro+, Samsung Galaxy A27 5G and More

description: The OnePlus Nord Buds 4 is a great budget-friendly package that punches far above its weight class. Even with all the corporate shifting happening in the background, OnePlus has proven they still know exactly how to nail a budget daily driver. The fit is comfortable, the design looks premium, ANC is dependable, and the sound is enjoyable. At Rs. 3,299, the OnePlus Nord Buds 4 are an easy recommendation and among the strongest all-rounders in their price segment.
title: OnePlus Nord Buds 4 Review: Pro Features, Budget Price
